name: search_hotel_knowledge
description: Search grounded hotel documents and enrich the matching chunks with reviewed Neo4j hotel facts. Does not provide live inventory or guaranteed availability.

name: create_reservation_request
description: Validate and create one reservation request for a hotel selected from grounded retrieval. This does not confirm a booking or room availability.

hotel_id.description: Opaque stable hotel ID returned by grounded retrieval.
